data.desc: Newsmax Inc. is listed on the NYSE (NMAX) and operates, through Newsmax Broadcasting LLC, one of the nation's leading news outlets, the Newsmax channel, which is carried on all major pay TV providers. Newsmax 's media properties - including Newsmax TV, Newsmax2, the Newsmax App, Newsmax.com, and Newsmax Magazine - reach tens of millions of Americans regularly across broadcast, cable, streaming, digital, and print platforms.
